title: Crystal growth
description: A smoky quartz cluster reveals sharp facets as its proportions change.
useCase: Gemology, material collections, and sculptural product accents.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. Opaque stylized quartz; no crystal refraction or mineral growth simulation.
look: Flat warm grey field with one matte sage-green cluster of pointed hexagonal quartz prisms, softly lit from the upper left with faint banding.
motion: The raymarched cluster turns continuously about its vertical axis at 0.12 rad/s, about 52 s per turn; the growth slider lengthens or shortens all five prisms.
adapt: The `FRAGMENT` shader raymarches `crystal`: five hexagonal prisms whose `height` adds `u_control*.4`, spun in `object` by `u_time*.12`. Tune `width`, the five-iteration loop and the shading colours in `c`; keep the context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
